title: Rivers Sands RV Resort

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Enjoy 265 full hook-up sites with 30/50 AMP service. Our big-rig-friendly back-in and pull-thru RV sites offer you beautiful views of the Colorado River and surrounding mountains with many activities for you to enjoy. It doesn’t matter if you’re here for some peace and quiet or to get adventurous; we provide you with modern comfort amid the scenic views of the Arizona desert. Furthermore, you’ll get to experience our top-of-the-line amenities that will surely tick all of your boxes. All Recreational Vehicles 20 years or newer can make a nightly or weekly reservations.
